from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests,json,hashlib
out=Path('reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1')
protocol=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
url=protocol['source_scope']['official_catalog_url'];attempts=[]
for attempt in range(1,3):
 r=None;a={'attempt':attempt,'requested_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()}
 try:
  r=requests.get(url,timeout=(15,35),headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)'})
  a['http_status']=r.status_code;r.raise_for_status()
  p=out/'sources/官方按年借款预估目录.html';p.write_bytes(r.content)
  a['status']='SAVED_ORIGINAL';attempts.append(a)
  soup=BeautifulSoup(r.content,'html.parser')
  print('目录表数：',len(soup.find_all('table')))
  for i,t in enumerate(soup.find_all('table')[:10]):
   print('表',i,'前节点：',str(t.find_previous(['h2','h3','p']))[:150],'表内：',' '.join(t.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())[:120])
   print('链接：',[(x.get_text(' ',strip=True),x.get('href')) for x in t.find_all('a')])
  break
 except Exception as e:
  a.update(status='FAILED',error=str(e)[:900]);attempts.append(a)
  if r is not None and r.status_code in (403,429):break
rec={'url':url,'attempts':attempts,'tls_verify':True}
if p.exists():rec.update(path=str(p).replace('\\','/'),sha256=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),bytes=p.stat().st_size)
(out/'catalog_receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(rec,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
